why: Code gets a smaller character set, and this case locks both edges of it. Measured in node_modules, honest source carries C0 sentinels (a YAML plugin uses U+0002, U+0018 and U+001F; a PNG magic uses U+001A), and failing them would put every vendored parser in the allowlist. So the pass side is src/a.mjs with U+0002 inside a string. The fail side is the same line with ESC instead, which a code file never needs raw: the escape can always be written as source text, which is how rebar fixed its own colour helper.
